title: FAQ
description: Frequently asked questions in an accordion, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Accordion, Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then one question per item that opens onto its answer, and a line that points to support, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the support line sits on one row at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the section gets more room above and below at @lg.
